linkedin.headline: Sustainability consultant | Greenfold Advisory
linkedin.about: I help councils and small firms cut carbon and plan renewables. I am calm, kind and community-minded, and I care about integrity in climate work. I tend an allotment, volunteer with a local repair cafe and keep a minimalist home. Looking for someone who wants a steady, grounded life and gives back to their community.
